leagues.name: NIAA Girls Volleyball
leagues.notes: Five enrollment classifications (1A–5A) each with regional conference league play and published standings; state championships in October–November

leagues.name: NIAA Boys Volleyball
leagues.notes: Classifications 3A–5A with conference league play and standings; one of Nevada's fastest-growing high school sports

leagues.name: NCVA Girls Power League
leagues.notes: $1,800/team; qualifier + 3 rounds of league play + regional championships; top competitive tier in NCVA; teams register via TM2Sign [auto-quarantine 2026-04-15: generic-platform:wordpress]

leagues.name: NCVA Girls Premier League
leagues.notes: $1,500/team; qualifier + 4 league events + Regional Championships in May; local district model (max ~90-min travel); seven districts including Northern Nevada [auto-quarantine 2026-04-15: generic-platform:wordpress]

leagues.name: NCVA Boys Power League
leagues.notes: $1,700/team; qualifier + 3 league rounds + regional championships; 2025-26 season postponed — non-league competition offered in its place; resumes 2026-27 [auto-quarantine 2026-04-15: generic-platform:wordpress]

leagues.name: SCSN Junior Girls
leagues.notes: Regional standings published throughout season; 20+ competitive divisions by level (Div 1–4 elite; Div 5+ open); 11U–14U tryouts October 2025; 12U uses lighter ball

leagues.name: West Coast Volleyball Association (WCVBA) — Girls
leagues.notes: 6 league events over 3 weekends; three divisions: 15-18 Open / 13-16 Championship / 12U Championship; clubs can simultaneously compete in USAV or AAU; NNJ is a member club

leagues.name: Northern Nevada Volleyball League (NNVL)
leagues.notes: $1,150/team; 4 single-day local tournaments + 2-day final championship; all venues in Reno / Sparks area; founded 2022 to reduce travel burden for Northern Nevada clubs [auto-quarantine 2026-04-15: generic-platform:wordpress]

leagues.name: National Youth Sports Nevada — Volleyball
leagues.notes: Parent-volunteer coached under certified clinician oversight; 20,000+ participants/year; multiple seasonal league sessions (winter, spring, etc.); skill-building focus

leagues.name: United States Youth Volleyball League — Reno
leagues.notes: Neil Road Recreation Center; 4 age divisions (7-8 / 9-10 / 11-12 / 13-15); Tuesdays + Saturdays; clinician-supervised; $150–$200/player; includes t-shirt and medal [auto-quarantine 2026-04-15: generic-platform:wordpress]

leagues.name: Las Vegas Volleyball League (LVL)
leagues.notes: Primarily boys-focused; pool play + bracket play format across a defined seasonal schedule; held at VUVC Training Center (3055 S Valley View Blvd); AAU membership noted for some divisions
